workload.data_boundary: Real 32_skip4, fixed engineering sample. Four independent workers replay the same frames. B32 is one fp32 update, with no accumulation.

memory_measurement.ordinary: Per-update Linux VmHWM, reset before timed training through /proc/self/clear_refs=5.
memory_measurement.hbm: Step-end HugetlbPages and local NUMA hugepage residency before/after observation. No arena release during worker.
memory_measurement.joint_peak_estimate: Per-worker per-step ordinary high-water plus unchanged HBM at start and end. This is a process estimate, separate from an instantaneous four-domain peak and from step-end total.
memory_measurement.step_end: VmRSS + HugetlbPages from the same /proc/self/status step-end sample.
memory_measurement.arena_counters: Allocator bump high-water and requested bytes. Requests are cumulative, not simultaneous allocation or physical bandwidth.
